extra.text: A wiry lad with Ida's red hair, restringing a bow on the lodge step. "Rook. Ma's told me about you. Wolf got you, eh? Got me too, once." He shows you a white crescent of scars on his wrist.

scenes.title: A snare
text: A hare hangs limp in the wire loop of one of Rook's snares.

choices.label: Take the hare and reset the snare
choices.result: You work the hare free and set the loop again the way Rook had it.

scenes.title: A snare
text: Another of Rook's snares, and another hare in it.

choices.label: Take the hare and reset the snare
choices.result: Two. You're getting the knack of the wire.

scenes.title: The last snare
text: A wolf has its muzzle in the last snare, tearing at what's left of a hare. It lifts its head and looks at you. Yellow eyes.

scenes.title: The snare robber
text: The wolf lies still. The hare it was eating is ruined, but in the brush beside the snare there's a second one, fresh, that it hadn't got to yet.

scenes.title: The den
text: Bones, old and new, scattered round a hollow under the rocks. Something huge gets up out of it, unhurried, and shakes itself. Grey going black along the spine, a scar across its muzzle, and eyes like two coals.

extra.text: Rook nocks an arrow beside you. His hands are shaking, but the arrow isn't. "That's him," he breathes.
You're on your own. That's a bad idea.

choices.label: Back off, for now
choices.result: You back away slowly. The pack leader watches you go, and doesn't bother to follow.

scenes.title: Away
text: You break away and run, and the pack leader lets you. It doesn't need to chase. It knows where you'll be.

scenes.title: The pack leader
text: The great wolf goes down at last, and doesn't get up. Up close, under the grey, its skin is mottled purple, like a bruise that never healed.

extra.text: Rook lowers his bow and sits down hard on a rock. "We did it," he says, as if he doesn't believe it. Then, more quietly: "Did you see its eyes?"

choices.label: Skin it and take the pelt to Ida
choices.result: It's heavy, bloody work, and it takes a while.

scenes.title: The stream
text: The stream runs quick and cold over the stones.

choices.label: Fill the pail
choices.result: You fill the pail to the brim. Ida will want it boiled before anyone drinks it.

choices.label: Drink and fill your waterskin
choices.result: It tastes of moss and stone. You drink, then fill the skin. Ida would tell you to boil it first.

scenes.title: Yarrow
text: Yarrow: flat white flower heads on feathery stems. Packed into a wound, it keeps it clean. It'll grow back.

choices.label: Pick some
choices.result: You pick a good handful and fold it into a cloth.

scenes.title: Yarrow
text: Yarrow: flat white flower heads on feathery stems. Packed into a wound, it keeps it clean. It'll grow back.

choices.label: Pick some
choices.result: You pick a good handful and fold it into a cloth.

scenes.title: A young willow
text: A young willow leaning over the stream. Its bark brings a fever down, chewed or brewed. Take a little and it'll mend.

choices.label: Strip some bark
choices.result: You peel a few strips from the side facing the water, and leave the rest.

scenes.title: The boar
text: A boar comes out of the bracken, bristles up, head low. It's bigger than you expected. It doesn't run.

choices.label: Back away
choices.result: You back off slowly. The boar snorts and goes back to rooting, but it doesn't take its eyes off you.

extra.text: Rook already has an arrow on the string. "Easy," he breathes. "It'll come at you when it's ready. Don't stand there when it does."
You're on your own, and it knows it.

scenes.title: Still
text: The boar goes down in the leaf litter and doesn't get up. Your hands are shaking.

extra.text: Rook lets out a whoop, then looks embarrassed about it. He has his knife out in a moment and shows you how to bleed it, open it and skin it. "Meat for the pot. Hide for Ma's rack. And these," the long white sinews down its back, "make bowstring. Nothing goes to waste in Skelmed. Can't afford it."

scenes.title: Away
text: You run, crashing through the bracken, until you're sure it isn't behind you.

extra.text: Rook catches you up, out of breath and grinning. "No shame in it. Get your wind back and we'll go again."

scenes.title: Deadwood
text: A fallen branch, grey and dry, half sunk in the moss.

choices.label: Gather it
choices.result: You snap it into lengths and bundle it under your arm.
